# Fallout: Season 2 - All broadcast dates for the first episodes on Amazon Prime

![Fallout: Season 2 - All broadcast dates for the first broadcast of the episodes on Amazon Prime](/uploads/609_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

After the super-successful 1st season of the Fallout TV series on Amazon Prime in 2024, we are now eagerly waiting for the 2nd season. On December 17th, 2025 the time has finally come. The new episodes are released weekly.

![](/uploads/fallout-season2-prime-start-dates.jpeg)

## What awaits us in season 2?

![Fallout: Season 2](/uploads/fallout-season2-hero.jpg) 

**Season 2 picks up directly from the end of Season 1.** Lucy MacLean and the Ghoul (Cooper Howard) continue their search for Lucy's father, Hank, who has fled in power armor towards **New Vegas**. The journey through the post-apocalyptic **Mojave Desert** and the dangerous city of New Vegas are the focus of the new season.

In New Vegas, the characters encounter well-known factions, iconic locations like the **Lucky 38 Casino** and legendary creatures like **Deathclaws** - elements that are strongly based on *Fallout: New Vegas*. At the same time, the series remains understandable even for viewers who do not know the games.

### Known roles from season 1

| Actor | role | 
| Ella Purnell | **Lucy MacLean** – Vault Dweller looking for answers. | 
| Walton Goggins | **The Ghoul / Cooper Howard** – once a Hollywood star, now a bounty hunter Ghoul | 
| Aaron Moten | **Maximus** – Member of the **Brotherhood of Steel** | 
| Kyle MacLachlan | **Hank MacLean** – Lucy and Norm's father | 
| Moises Arias | **Norm MacLean** – Lucy's brother | 
| Xelia Mendes Jones | **Dane** – Brotherhood Scribe | 

### New faces in season 2

- 
**Justin Theroux** plays*Robert (Mr.) House* – the enigmatic ruler of New Vegas
- 
**Macaulay Culkin** appears in a slightly crazy role in the setting of **Caesar's Legion**.

## Parallels to Fallout 76

The latest update to Fallout 76 “Burning Springs” was released on December 2nd, 2025 and brings with it numerous parallels to the Fallout series.

![](/uploads/f76-burningsprings-3840x2160.jpg)

- The ghoul himself can now be found in the game. In some places he shows players the way to Highway Town in the new "Burning Springs" region. And in Highway Town he personally gives out bounty contracts to the players. Players can start small routine hunts or start public bounty hunting events in which all players in a world can take part.
- The new region "Burning Springs" is a map expansion west into the Ohio desert. There is no New Vegas there, but the environment is very close to the Mojave Desert.
- New weapon: The Ghoul Revolver has also found its way into Fallout 76. Players can earn it in the current season 23 and equip it with some unique mods as they wish.
- Season 23 has the motto “Blood x Rust” and primarily focuses on the desert and raiders.
- New Events: The new public event "Well Equipped" is about protecting an armored Deathclaw. And we will also see deathclaws in the second season of the series. We'll soon find out whether they're armored
